scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run api:spec:check && pnpm -r --if-present run build && bash -c 'cd artifacts/api-python && uv run pytest -q'
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run api:spec:check && bash -c 'cd artifacts/api-python && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check app/domain app/repositories app/seeds'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/infosutra" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.api:spec: cd artifacts/api-python && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.api:client: pnpm run api:spec && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen
scripts.api:spec:check: bash -c 'tmp=$(mktemp) && cp lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml "$tmp" && pnpm run api:spec && diff -q "$tmp" lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml; status=$?; rm -f "$tmp"; exit $status'
